svg.title: Gap of the GA menu options to the exact options, typed fleets (WP-E4a)
svg.desc: Per-option duration gap gD against students per wave, one panel per fleet and R, marker by dK, colour by option kind.
svg.text: Gap of the GA menu options to the exact options, typed fleets (WP-E4a)
Snapshot week 2026-10-05; GA = one seed-42 native run (WP-E10 re-run); exact_reference_v1; fleets in separate panels
base (K, xbase vs GA base); dK = 0, y = gD
q (K_m, xq vs GA q); dK = 0, y = gD
dK >= 1, gD not defined: y = gD_free (hollow)
A point is one wave (or option) per distinct (students, y); 'xN' = N coincident rows. Base and q are offset by +-0.14 students.
